hikes.name: Hurricane Hill
hikes.blurb: A paved, then open ridge to a summit with the Bailey Range's glaciers on one side and the Strait on the other.

hikes.name: Klahhane Ridge
hikes.blurb: Along the ridge past Sunrise Point to a rocky crest looking down 5,000 feet to Port Angeles.

hikes.name: Lake Angeles
hikes.blurb: A steady forest climb to a lake with an island, set in a cirque under Klahhane Ridge.

hikes.name: Grand Valley
hikes.blurb: Along the high, treeless Lillian Ridge and down into a valley of lakes and marmot meadows.

hikes.name: Royal Basin
hikes.blurb: Up Royal Creek to a meadow basin with a lake under Mt Deception's glaciers and the Needles.

hikes.name: Marmot Pass
hikes.blurb: Up the Big Quilcene to a dry, open pass in the Olympics' rain shadow, Buckhorn and the Needles in view.

hikes.name: Mount Townsend
hikes.blurb: Rhododendrons, then open ridge to a summit that sees from Baker to Rainier across Puget Sound.

hikes.name: Lena Lake
hikes.blurb: An easy, popular climb to a forest lake with campsites on its shore.

hikes.name: Upper Lena Lake
hikes.blurb: Past Lena Lake and up a rough, steep trail to a high lake under Mt Bretherton.

hikes.name: Mount Ellinor
hikes.blurb: A short, steep climb up a rock gully to a summit looking down on Lake Cushman and Hood Canal.

hikes.name: Staircase Rapids
hikes.blurb: An easy walk up the North Fork Skokomish under huge trees to a string of rapids.

hikes.name: Flapjack Lakes
hikes.blurb: Up the North Fork and a steep side trail to twin lakes under the jagged Sawtooth Range.

hikes.name: Dungeness Spit
hikes.blurb: Out along one of the world's longest sand spits to an 1857 lighthouse, seals and seabirds on the way.

hikes.name: Blue Mountain (Deer Park)
hikes.blurb: A short loop at the top of a winding road with a full view of the Olympics and across the Strait.

hikes.name: Buckhorn Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Upper Big Quilcene Trailhead, a 12.1-mile round trip to the top of Buckhorn Mountain (6,966 ft), with about 4,700 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Welch Peaks
hikes.blurb: From Mount Townsend Upper Trailhead, a 7.2-mile round trip to the top of Welch Peaks (5,654 ft), with about 2,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lake of the Angels
hikes.blurb: From Putvin Trailhead, a 6.7-mile round trip to Lake of the Angels, with about 3,650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Harrison Lake
hikes.blurb: From Dosewallips River Trailhead, a 7.3-mile round trip to Harrison Lake, with about 4,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Happy Lake
hikes.blurb: From Happy Lake Ridge Trailhead, a 9.6-mile round trip to Happy Lake, with about 4,350 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Wagonwheel Lake
hikes.blurb: From North Fork Skokomish/Wagonwheel Lake Trailhead, a 5.1-mile round trip to Wagonwheel Lake, with about 3,400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount Angeles
hikes.blurb: From Switchback Trailhead, a 3.4-mile round trip to the top of Mount Angeles (6,036 ft), with about 1,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mildred Lakes
hikes.blurb: From Mildred Lakes Trailhead, a 7.4-mile round trip to Mildred Lakes, with about 3,200 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Striped Peak
hikes.blurb: From Striped Peak Trailhead, a 3.6-mile round trip to the top of Striped Peak (1,140 ft), with about 1,200 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount Rose
hikes.blurb: From Mount Rose Trailhead, a 5.2-mile round trip to the top of Mount Rose (4,282 ft), with about 3,450 feet of climbing.
